title: Implement Multi-Channel Data Drift Alerting for Model Monitoring
description: The InsightHexaAI suite currently provides robust model monitoring, but lacks a proactive alerting mechanism for data drift. This task involves implementing a new feature to detect significant shifts in the statistical distribution of incoming inference data compared to a model's training data baseline. This feature must be configurable, integrate with the existing notification system, and be covered by a new integration test. The work will be performed over three distinct development sessions.

project_spec.name: InsightHexaAI: Strategic ML Inference Suite for Enterprise KPIs
project_spec.description:
InsightHexaAI is an expert-level TypeScript platform that empowers large enterprises to turn predictive models into continuously-improving, revenue-impacting services. Centered on a strict hexagonal (ports-and-adapters) architecture, the project isolates core business logic—profit-driven metrics, customer-lifetime-value forecasts, churn-risk scores—from volatile outside concerns such as data lakes, BI tools, model registries, and visualization dashboards. 

Every feature—experiment_tracking, feature_store, model_versioning, automated_retraining, and real-time model_serving—is expressed as a set of domain services inside the hexagon. External technologies (Kafka, S3, TensorFlow, Snowflake, PowerBI, etc.) are merely adapters, allowing the core to uphold business rules like SLA-aware inference pricing or regulatory audit trails. Strategy_Pattern and Factory_Pattern implementations let product managers swap revenue strategies (e.g., usage-based billing vs. subscription) or model-selection strategies (A/B vs. multi-armed bandit) without touching IO code. Observer_Pattern feeds dashboards and alerts whenever KPIs drift, while Pipeline_Pattern orchestrates preprocessing → feature_engineering → training → evaluation → deployment pipelines in code, not YAML, giving finance teams traceable cost attribution.

With 98 cohesive files planned (≈741 k tokens), InsightHexaAI becomes the authoritative backbone for enterprise ML operations, tightly aligning technical excellence with measurable business outcomes.
dependencies: inversify or tsyringe (dependency injection for ports/adapters)
bullmq or agenda (job orchestration for pipelines)
typeorm or prisma (feature store / metadata DB)
mlflow-rest-client or custom Model Registry SDK
fastify or nestjs (HTTP/gRPC ports for model_serving)
